name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
summary: In Cathedral Square, Orphan Matron Nightingale cares for Stormwind’s orphaned children. With Matron Shellene, she gives them shelter and guidance, and welcomes Alliance adventurers during Children's Week.

sections.title: Guardian of the Displaced
sections.body: Outside the orphanage, south-east of the Cathedral of Light, Orphan Matron Nightingale cares for children left without homes or parents. Recent wars, gnoll attacks, and the rise of the Defias Brotherhood have brought many to her door. Under the Church of the Holy Light’s watch, Nightingale and Matron Shellene give them shelter, basic care, and guidance.

sections.title: Children's Week Patron
sections.body: Matron Nightingale knows children need hope as well as food and shelter. Each Children's Week, she asks Alliance heroes to take an orphan on journeys across Azeroth. She hopes that meeting celebrated champions will build their confidence and show them the wider world beyond the city walls. Above all, she wants them to know they are not forgotten.

faq.q: Where can Orphan Matron Nightingale be found?
faq.answer: Orphan Matron Nightingale can be found outside the Stormwind Orphanage in Cathedral Square, south-east of the Cathedral of Light.

faq.q: Why are there so many orphans in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Stormwind has many orphans because devastating wars, including the Third War, and ongoing skirmishes with the Defias Brotherhood, orc remnants, and hostile beasts have killed many city residents and frontier farmers. Their children have been left without homes.
Children's Week is an annual Stormwind celebration organized by Matron Nightingale. Alliance adventurers chaperone an orphan on journeys to see the wonders and heroes of the wider world.

faq.q: Who helps Matron Nightingale run the orphanage?
faq.answer: Matron Shellene helps Nightingale raise, feed, and shelter the children in and around the orphanage.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you see in Nightingale the quiet cost of war. You also share the duty to protect the realm’s future generations.
As a priest, you recognize the compassion and service Nightingale shows outside the Cathedral of Light. These are virtues that priests of the Holy Light uphold.
